name: Jiangsu Communications Digital Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Tongxingbao Intelligent Transportation Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides smart transportation platform solutions for highways, trunk roads, and urban transportation in China. The company is involved in the smart transportation electronic toll collection (ETC) business, including ETC issuance and sales, and electronic toll collection service business; and the smart transportation operation management system business, including smart transportation operation management system software development, and solutions and system technology services provision.
